prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry and whether you need SEO, paid media, creative, web/app build, B2B vs B2C, etc.

To help you quickly, tell me:
- What are your primary goals? (lead gen, brand awareness, e‑commerce revenue, user acquisition, content, SEO, website/app build)
- Monthly or campaign budget range?
- Company type/size & industry (startup, SMB, enterprise; SaaS, retail, fintech, consumer, etc.)
- Do you want a local agency that can meet in person?
- Timeline / important deadlines?

How I can help next
- If you give the details above, I’ll shortlist 4–6 San Francisco agencies that match your needs, with strengths, likely pricing range, and questions to ask them.
- Or, if you prefer, I can immediately list several well-regarded SF agencies and what they’re known for — tell me which you prefer.
